Rows.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM SpecObj s JOIN galSpecInfo i ON s.specObjID=i.specObjID JOIN PhotoObj p ON s.bestObjID=p.objID JOIN galSpecExtra x ON s.specObjID=x.specObjID WHERE s.class='GALAXY' AND s.z>=0.08 AND s.z<0.12 AND x.lgm_tot_p50>=8 AND x.lgm_tot_p50<9.5 AND x.specsfr_tot_p50 BETWEEN -14 AND -7
